DomainParticipant.description: Creates a DDS domain participant on the specified domain.

Duration.description: Represents a time duration for DDS operations.

key_methods.wait_for_acknowledgments: writer.wait_for_acknowledgments(max_wait) - Block until all written samples are acknowledged by matched readers. Raises dds.TimeoutError on timeout.
key_methods.matched_subscriptions: writer.matched_subscriptions - Property returning list of InstanceHandles for matched DataReaders
key_methods.matched_subscription_data: writer.matched_subscription_data(handle) - Get SubscriptionBuiltinTopicData for a matched reader

key_methods.take: reader.take() - Take (remove) all available samples from the reader cache
key_methods.read: reader.read() - Read all available samples without removing them
key_methods.matched_publications: reader.matched_publications - Property returning list of InstanceHandles for matched DataWriters
key_methods.matched_publication_data: reader.matched_publication_data(handle) - Get PublicationBuiltinTopicData for a matched writer

sample_access.description: Samples from take()/read() have .info and .data attributes

builtin_topics.description: DDS provides built-in topics for discovering remote entities.

subscription_reader.description: DataReader for DCPSSubscription built-in topic. Returns samples with .data containing: key (BuiltinTopicKey/GUID), topic_name, type_name, participant_key.

guid_formatting.description: BuiltinTopicKey contains a .value attribute with 4 unsigned 32-bit integers. To format as a human-readable GUID string:
guid_formatting.pattern:
import struct

def format_guid(key):
    raw = key.value  # tuple of 4 uint32
    all_bytes = []
    for v in raw:
        all_bytes.extend(struct.pack('>I', v))
    prefix = '.'.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in all_bytes[:12])
    entity = '.'.join(f'{b:x}' for b in all_bytes[12:16])
    return f'{prefix}|{entity}'

DurabilityKind.VOLATILE: No durability - samples not stored. Late joiners miss everything.
DurabilityKind.TRANSIENT_LOCAL: Writer caches samples in memory. Late joiners receive cached data.
DurabilityKind.TRANSIENT: Samples survive writer crash (stored by durability service).
DurabilityKind.PERSISTENT: Samples survive system restart (stored to disk).

ReliabilityKind.BEST_EFFORT: No delivery guarantees. Fast but unreliable.
ReliabilityKind.RELIABLE: Acknowledged delivery with resend. Required for late-joiner delivery with TRANSIENT_LOCAL.

HistoryKind.KEEP_LAST: Keep only the last N samples (default depth=1). Warning: depth=1 means only the most recent sample is kept!
HistoryKind.KEEP_ALL: Keep all samples until acknowledged. Required when multiple samples must be delivered to late joiners.

exceptions.TimeoutError: dds.TimeoutError - Raised when a DDS operation exceeds its timeout. Catch this when using receive_replies() or wait_for_acknowledgments().

dynamic_types.description: Create DDS types dynamically without IDL or @idl.struct.
dynamic_types.pattern:
hello_type = dds.StructType('HelloWorld')
hello_type.add_member(dds.Member(name='msg', data_type=dds.StringType(256)))
hello_type.add_member(dds.Member(name='count', data_type=dds.Int32Type()))
topic = dds.DynamicData.Topic(participant, 'HelloWorld', hello_type)
